'''''Star Wars: Chewbacca''''' is a five-issue [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries by [[Gerry Duggan]], with art by [[Phil Noto]]. The series, set directly after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], began on [[October 14]], [[2015]], and concluded on [[December 30]], 2015. The story sees [[Chewbacca]], the titular character, temporarily stranded on a [[planet]] during a mission for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]]. With the help of a friend, he comes into conflict with the [[Galactic Empire]].
